title: Scenario adapter scoring does not mutate state
objective: Verify that the scenario adapter's scoring engine (evaluate_submission) is a pure function with no side effects — no file writes, no database access, no state changes.

source.description: The scenario adapter is a port of V1.5 scoring.js — a pure function with no side effects

execution.criteria: Evaluate the same scenario with the same inputs twice and verify identical results
execution.expected_outcome: evaluate_submission() is deterministic — same inputs always produce same outputs

evidence_required: Same inputs produce identical score, percentage, passed

pass_criteria.description: No file system writes during evaluation
evidence_required: Adapter produces no output files — result returned as JSON

pass_criteria.description: Result includes provenance block with advisory_only=True
